conventions.units: SI: m, m/s, kg, kW, m^2, J/kg, deg/s, mil (1 m at 1000 m). Original units kept in notes.
conventions.conditions: Sea level, combat mass, military power unless the field says otherwise. 'military' = the highest rating without emergency boost or injection (US 15-min military; RAF +18 lb 'combat' 5-min rating; German Start- und Notleistung; for the Bf 109 K-4 the 1.80 ata MW 50 rating, its standard combat setting). 'wep' = war emergency / water or MW 50 / 150-grade +25 lb.
conventions.confidence: good = primary or near-primary test document read tonight (or its faithful transcription); medium = primary figure via secondary summary, or a standard figure from memory consistent with sources; low = secondary/forum/simulator or conflicting; estimated = computed or reasoned, method stated.
conventions.estimates: Fields marked estimated come from the point-mass model in build/physics.py (propeller thrust min(0.7 x momentum-theory static thrust, 0.8 P / V); drag C_D0 + C_L^2/(pi e AR)). Use them for relative balance more than as absolutes.
conventions.dispersion: Cone diameters containing 75% / 100% of rounds. Installed values include the mounting (wing flex, synchronisation). The game fires along the nose with no convergence: dispersion_volley_* is the pure gun spread; gun_spacing_angle_at_300m is extra geometric spread if wing guns were parallel.
